props.name: rows
props.description: Rows to display. undefined means still loading.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, passed through to DataTable.

props.name: title
props.description: Title shown in the card header.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the table. Defaults to the title.

props.name: matchesFilter
props.description: Decides whether a row matches the active filters.

props.name: searchIn
props.description: Fields searched by the search field.

props.name: status
props.description: Explicit status. Omit and it is derived from `rows`.

props.name: emptyTitle
props.description: Copy for the no-data case, before any filtering.

props.name: emptyDescription
props.description: Second line of the no-data case.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls in the header — an export button, a date range.
